Cultivation is to let go for the time being, don't think about it, this kind of thing can't be rushed, the four elements of cultivation, the law of wealth, couple, law and land, are indispensable, if ordinary people lack the same, it can be said that they have gone astray, and it will be difficult for a lifetime. Inch.

As for Zhong Yu, the element of earth is a good cultivation environment, and he does not need any aura of heaven and earth for cultivation, and directly absorbs the purest luck, which can be said to directly eliminate the need for this aspect.

As for the method, all the key points of cultivation before and after the entire Tianyi Emperor Gong, the continuation and expansion of the method, were completely and systematically displayed in front of him.

There is no such bad habit of the so-called teaching skills in ancient times, and you have to cover up and hide them in the practice skills, so that no one will know. That is to say, you don't have to worry about the direction of your future practice. manage?

As for the companion, it is about people who progress together with themselves, resolve mutual confusion, and develop together towards the Dao. They are not the kind of Taoist companions that many people think of, although Taoist companions are also part of the companion at certain times.

With the system, you can ask the system for any confusion you encounter in practice. Why do you need others to comprehend the problems and omissions of the exercises together with you! He even shared his secrets with others.

And most importantly, as an emperor, he doesn't need any friendship, nor does he need any master. All he needs is a courtier, a courtier who can carry out his orders and share his worries.

And I have all three of the four types in place, the only thing that is missing is the financial aspect. It's hard for a clever woman to cook without rice, and you don't even have the most basic luck needed for cultivation, so how can you be diligent!

So the most important thing now is not how to practice, but how to plunder the most luck in this battle, so that your cultivation speed can be faster, and let yourself have enough luck points to increase your own luck. The background of the empire, so as to increase the confidence for his next plunder of the heavens and the world.

Thinking of this, the purple-golden air in Zhong Yu's body circulated slowly through the meridians again, and finally merged into the dantian, condensed into a ball, and slowly rotated, like a water ball, thus ending the last luck practice of the day.

Slowly opened his eyes, in his eyes, a purple-gold light flashed away, breathtaking, and then disappeared in a flash, making people think it was an illusion, this is the practice of kung fu that is close to Xiaocheng, but has not yet Consummation, the true energy in the body spontaneously burst out.

Zhong Yu's current strength, according to the information he got from the system, and the comparison with other cultivation systems, plus the verification he got from the system, according to his estimation, his current strength should be at the fourth level.

He heard it right, it was the fourth level. Zhong Yu started to cultivate when he destroyed the Han Dynasty, went through aristocratic families from all over the world, killed nearly half of the world's population, and started after he got enough luck.

That is to say, the period when he sent troops to the Northern Expedition was only a year or two or three months ago. In such a short period of time, he achieved what other people could not achieve in forty or fifty years, or even in his entire life. It is progressing rapidly.

The reason is that his starting point was too high. From the very beginning of his practice, this technique was attached to a will that belonged exclusively to the emperor. The momentum and majesty brought by the people.

It can be said that his starting point is too high. When he first started to practice, he was born with a kind of will. This kind of will can only be possessed by an emperor. Other common people, nobles, and even some mediocre emperors do not have it.

Often only those great and talented founding emperors, or a generation of heroes who expanded the territory, after sending troops and conquests time and time again, and suppressing the officials above the court, can cultivate this kind of world, the only one who respects me spirit and mind.

In addition, the power used in his cultivation is the most original luck, which directly makes up for and eliminates the stage of the second and third ranks, the process of condensing and growing, refining and tempering his extraordinary power, after condensing the internal energy , directly became a Tier 4 powerhouse!

Although Zhong Yu's combat experience and strength of true qi are not as good as those of the fourth-order self-cultivated step by step, his true qi will, which belongs to the emperor alone, and comes with a layer of heavenly breath, can be naturally suppressed. Those ordinary wills rising from the recklessness, even if the will of the top powerhouses among the fourth ranks comprehends higher than most people, as long as he is still in this world and in this country, then he must be affected. Heaven and the country's oppression had to succumb.

Just like every country has certain offerings, which are specially raised to be powerful thugs, to guard against the assassination and provocation of certain strong men. As for the strong directly breaking the rules and killing the emperor himself to become the boss, that is even more so. Just kidding.

First of all, the nobles, and the soldiers at the bottom, the civilians will not recognize, and the high gods above, will not tolerate those mortals breaking his already stable belief area, causing his own belief income to be turbulent.

Losing the support of the bottom and the top at the same time, even if you have the mighty force that overwhelms the world, what use is it? It will not be completely submerged under the continuous attack.

Therefore, the strong in the heavens and the world, either choose a powerful force to take refuge in, or be their own lone ranger, and never take the initiative to provoke those big forces, even if they are provoked by a big force, they will choose to swallow their anger , this is revealed.

At that time, their subjective intentions have already succumbed to the gods who are the representative of the heaven and the country, and the will that they have comprehended will be faced with Zhong, who has the breath of heaven and the most representative emperor status of humanity since ancient times. Yu, who was born short before the battle, was suppressed by Zhong Yu.

Then the most representative comprehension wills of their fourth-order will become a complete joke, unable to play any role, then they will become a more powerful third-order that’s all.

And the third-tier powerhouse needs thirty or forty people to defeat the weakest fourth-tier, regardless of their lives. It is very difficult to kill!

Not to mention that in the fourth level, except for the fact that his true qi background is a bit weak, it will take him a year or two to make up for it, but in other aspects, he is the most powerful, unmatched Zhong Yu, and I am afraid that hundreds of people will not be enough to come to it Die!

Therefore, Zhong Yu is quite disdainful of the three major barbarian forces that do not even have a fifth-order powerhouse among the mortals on the entire plain!

Even among these savages, not to mention the fifth level, even the fourth level combined, it is doubtful whether there are twenty of them!

As far as Zhong Yu knows, in the entire El tribal alliance, apart from the leader tribe, there are also leaders of other three tribes with more than 30,000 people. , and not many.

And their lord tribe, whose strength can suppress the barbarians in the entire Edel tribe alliance, is naturally impossible, but there are more warriors in the tribe alone, and there are many high-level combat powers in it, and there are also two of them in total .

According to intelligence investigation, they are their leader and the great elder in the leader's tribe, and the leader's tribe is also in a state of constant internal fighting because there is a great elder who can stand up to him.

A lot of power has been wasted for no reason in internal fighting, and it cannot be used for external expansion, which is a pity!
